children.text: Created a calm, ad-free alternative to social media.

We built a mobile app for mindful reading using RSS and Atom feeds—designed to be simple, private, and distraction-free. Developed in React Native with a Supabase backend, Cureader evolves through user feedback and community interviews.
Designed a simple and fast way to quote insurance plans online.

We built a responsive web app that collects user info and delivers personalized insurance quotes, fully integrated with Chomp’s backend tools. A full redesign brought in bright colors, clear typography, and subtle animations—making the process intuitive, on-brand, and reliable.
Built the first inclusive photo editing app for diverse skin tones.

We partnered with Capture Noire to design and build a melanin-friendly photo editing app. After launching a native iOS MVP that helped secure funding, we led the next phase across iOS and Android, developed a shared Firebase backend, and mentored Capture Noire’s growing Android team.
Built a website that matches the vibe of this beloved pizzeria.

We developed a Shopify-powered site for Talula’s Pizza that showcases their brand and supports merch, menu updates, and events. It’s easy to manage and helps extend the restaurant’s local cult following online.
Upgraded an online store to support fast growth.

As Hazel expanded its East Coast presence, we rebuilt their Shopify site to match. We implemented custom features like text/email marketing, product suggestions, and inventory tools—all aligned with their trendy, accessible brand.
Designed a platform to connect personal trainers with clients.

We led foundational research and built a strong MVP for Train Market’s two-sided marketplace. The project included user interviews, product strategy, and design systems—positioning them to raise investment and grow the platform.
Launched a scalable, mobile-first accessibility assessment platform.

We designed and developed the SPHERE mobile app. Built for both iOS and Android, the app includes a self-assessment tool with over 800 questions and personalized resources and recommendations. It supports INNoVA’s mission to improve accessibility for businesses and communities and serves as the foundation for new service offerings and business initiatives.
Launched a clean, coastal-inspired ecommerce site.

We built Flora & Mar’s Shopify site to reflect their values: natural ingredients, transparency, and small-batch care. The site supports subscriptions, wholesale accounts, and inventory management—designed to scale with their growing footprint.
Improved brand, tools, and operations for a creative studio.

We helped Current upgrade their website, create a brand system (logo, type, usage), and streamline internal workflows. Our work also supported their move to a new studio, resulting in stronger client relationships and more efficient day-to-day operations.
Stepped in to stabilize and improve a high-traffic Shopify Plus store.

We provided ongoing support for a nationally known boutique facing legacy tech issues. Our work fixed broken flows, improved site speed, and boosted performance for tens of thousands of daily visitors.
